title: Profile: seller.draft.fetchExact
description: Canonical profile for fetching one exact seller draft.
text:
# seller.draft.fetchExact

TL;DR:
- Use seller.draftFetch when you already know the draft id or have a very tight query.
- This is the normal step before patching, gallery replacement, or publish decisions.
whenToUse: When one exact draft is needed before seller.draftPatch or seller.draftGalleryCreate.
minimumInputs: filter.id or another query narrow enough to resolve one draft
recommended: Preserve draft.id from the result for later write steps.
avoid: Do not use draftCollection if you only need one exact draft.
exampleInterpretation: The returned draft is the canonical current state before patch or publish.
